text_block_list.text:
T… that was amazing…!
Ardan-san and the president's performance
was so…!… Uh,
huh? Did the song just change…?!
text_block_list.name: Umamusume B

text_block_list.text: At the tail end of a glorious history—
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace

text_block_list.text:
Common sense and conventions are born,
and if they obstruct the road ahead—
text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.text:
We'll crush every wall in front of us here
and now!
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace

text_block_list.text:
Hyaa?! C-C.B.
and Ace-san?!
Ah- they're starting to draw… a dragon—?!
text_block_list.name: Umamusume B

text_block_list.text: Hah!
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Don't look so shocked… I gotcha right where
I wanted!)

(History and tradition,
all that stiff stuff's fine and dandy,
but… if all that doesn't ring a bell to ya,
then take a good look!)
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace

text_block_list.text: Ei! Yah!
text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.text:
(Aaah,
I knew it. This is super fun…! Challenges,
rebellion,
a journey where I'm not held back by
anything—)
text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.text:
(Yeah,
yeah! All these words feel just right!
We're the ones who'll go on how we want,
and live the way we want!)
text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.text: Ace!
text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

We'll light a fire in your hearts in one go
this New Year's!
If you feel your strength start to overflow
from within— go on and run it all out!
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace

text_block_list.text:
It's okay—
leave it to us to light the way ahead!
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace

text_block_list.text: Wherever you want to go— you're free!
text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.text: Hehe… ehehe… hehehehehe!
text_block_list.name: Maruzensky

text_block_list.text:
(Aaah,
gosh!
C.B.-chan and Ace-chan… Rudolf and Ardan-chan…
you're all so wicked bodacious!)
text_block_list.name: Maruzensky

text_block_list.text: (Which is why— ehe, I got selfish. ♪)
text_block_list.name: Maruzensky

text_block_list.text:
(Of course,
performing together with Rudolf and Ardan-chan
would've been totally tubular.)
text_block_list.name: Maruzensky

text_block_list.text:
(But I also ended up wanting to do something
only I could! 
So… I pulled out～ teehee. ♪)
text_block_list.name: Maruzensky

text_block_list.text:
Th-the song changed again! Shh… 
Wait,
is it starting to snow? Is that… petals…?!
text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I've witnessed many wishes. 
I've witnessed many resolves.

Even dreams that seemed as though they would
disappear halfway through… and hearts that
had lost their way.
text_block_list.name: Maruzensky

text_block_list.text:
At times like that— remember.
The very first day. 
The joy you felt taking that first step.
text_block_list.name: Maruzensky

text_block_list.text: Remember that this place is your story.
text_block_list.name: Maruzensky

text_block_list.text:
Let us put our hands together and pray for
each and every one of us.
That we may follow our hearts—
and run as far as we desire!
text_block_list.name: Maruzensky

text_block_list.text:
(… Just kidding.
I'm playing the role of a goddess,
but I've got another selfish wish in the
back of my head.)
text_block_list.name: Maruzensky

text_block_list.text:
(Because it's something I just thought
of! 
… Hey, everyone. You know…)
text_block_list.name: Maruzensky

text_block_list.text: (… I'm sick of traveling alone.)
text_block_list.name: Maruzensky

text_block_list.text:
(So, guys! You, you, and you— grit your teeth,
bare your fangs, and come at me!))
text_block_list.name: Maruzensky

text_block_list.text: (Won't you satisfy little ol' me?)
text_block_list.name: Maruzensky

text_block_list.text: Hehe… just kidding! ♪
text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
… I feel like… they showed us something 
totally crazy this new year's…

Yeah… It was really awesome… and dazzling…!
But, I just…!
text_block_list.name: Umamusume B

text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I can't explain it…! But right now,
I really, really—
text_block_list.name: Umamusume A

text_block_list.text: —want to run!!!
text_block_list.name: Both of them

text_block_list.text:
Thus,
this year's calligraphy performance raised
both a tremendous excitement and lit a fire
in everyone's hearts—

—Mejiro Ardan!
Are you finished changing?
I'd like to speak to you regarding the report
I am to make at the student council's
office…
text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf

text_block_list.text: … Ah.
text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf

text_block_list.text:
…! So I take it—
that you were watching the performance?
Yes… Understood…!!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
… Yes. I took some personal liberties, 
but as your replacement—
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
No… As the leading role that you've entrusted
to me,
I've fulfilled my duty to the best of my
ability.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
! Eh… is that… truly alright?
You made the preparations yourself,
nee-sama? Ah- yes!… Understood.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
I will return home tomorrow with my head
held high.
I'm looking forward to our tea party
together.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
